integrity: The selection law is derived from the exact simplex-regularized subproblem and exact parameter update. Numerical replay is supporting verification only, and unsuccessful searches are not treated as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to a deterministic one-dimensional symmetric two-objective quadratic family with an interior start.
The sufficient condition \(\sigma_0\ge1\) is used to keep every multiplicative state factor positive; necessity is not claimed.
No claim is made for nonsummable Tikhonov schedules, noisy gradients, or general Pareto-set geometries.
Targeted literature searches reduce but do not eliminate the risk of an equivalent prior selection result.
title: Summable Tikhonov weights do not select the center of a symmetric Pareto interval
